records.quote: Theorem 4.3 Let both X and Y follow the multiple-outlier PO model such that Xi ∼ P O(F̄ , λ1 ), Yi ∼ P O(F̄ , µ1 ), for i = 1, ..., n1 , Xj ∼ P O(F̄ , η), Yj ∼ P O(F̄ , η), for j = n1 + 1, ..., n1 + n2 (= n). Then λ1 ≤ η ≤ µ1 ⇒ Xn:n .rhr Yn:n .
records.family: multiple-outlier PO model with common second-block level η
records.compared: first level λ1 vs µ1 with shared level η

conclusion.direction: Xn:n ≺_rhr Yn:n (printed '.rhr'); proof shows r̃_{Yn:n}(x)/r̃_{Xn:n}(x) increasing — consistent with Definition 2.3(2)(ii), i.e., X ages faster in reversed hazard rate
